title: backlog.py claim writes the claims ledger under the lock record_worker takes, so a dispatch running beside a claim keeps its record
goal: bl_items.cmd_claim reads and writes the claims ledger inside bl_dispatch.ledger_lock with a temp file of its own, so a claim made while a dispatch's record_worker runs loses neither the claim's record nor the worker's worker_pid and worker_session
notes: Found by the SP-g2ssvhi2 review (S3): bl_items.py:236-240 writes the ledger with write_text (truncate, then write) from a read taken at the start of cmd_claim; a locked record_worker reading the truncated file gets ValueError and writes a ledger of its item alone, or claim's stale write drops a worker_session record_worker just wrote, and land then names no worker session. BG-chw4sg54's gate g1 was answered 'record_worker only', which left this open; its notes said the worker would file it, and the worker filed nothing.
